fully_correct_question_rate_meaning: Confirmed-correct lower bound over every reference question; unevaluable questions are unresolved, not failed.

atomic.match_rate_meaning: Confirmed-match lower bound among known expected atoms; this excludes unknown atomic denominators and does not mark unevaluable atoms wrong.

questions.prompt: What are the hash values (MD5 & SHA-1) of all images? Does the acquisition and verification hash value match?
questions.reason: The Possible Answer omits RM#1 and does not answer the acquisition-versus-verification subquestion. Listed digests are retained, but a full-question expected answer is incomplete.

questions.prompt: Identify the partition information of PC image.
questions.reason: PDF inspection confirms the asterisk is printed on partition 2, while raw-image partition boot flags differ. Whether the key means the OS boot partition or the MBR active flag needs independent review. Keep the printed candidate values; do not replace them from our evidence.

questions.prompt: Explain installed OS information in detail. (OS name, install date, registered owner…)
What is the timezone setting?
What is the computer name?
List all accounts in OS except the system accounts: Administrator, Guest, systemprofile, LocalService, NetworkService. (Account name, login count, last logon date…)
questions.reason: Table says only timezone applied; its offset relative to Q4/Q12 needs independent review. Local printed values retained without choosing the old reference's inferred UTC-5.

questions.prompt: Who was the last user to logon into PC?
When was the last recorded shutdown date/time?
Explain the information of network interface(s) with an IP address assigned by DHCP.
What applications were installed by the suspect after installing OS?
questions.reason: The timezone-applied caption does not resolve the table's offset relative to other tables. Preserve printed local times pending independent review; do not inherit the old reference's inferred UTC-5.
